''See also: [[Sylvan Riverseed Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] is a type of natural [[spirit]], similar to a [[Remnant]] but formed from the accumulation of balanced [[vital aura]] rather than the death of a [[sacred artist]]. These spirits are born in environments where different [[aspects]] of [[aura]] exist in perfect equilibrium, such as areas with a strong balance between life and [[water]]. While they are known for being gentle and flexible, possessing the ability to support or work with nearly any power aspect, they are also highly valued as raw materials. Skilled craftsmen can transform them into various objects, including weapons, guides, power sources, [[elixirs]], or guardians. A [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] can be nurtured and grown using a supply of [[pure madra]], though its successful development is not certain. Physically, they can appear as small, humanoid figures made of flowing blue waves or [[madra]] that mimics [[water]]. They are capable of communication through sounds, gestures, and impressions. In certain contexts, they have been used to cleanse or rebalance a person's [[madra channels]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] is a humanoid [[Remnant]] composed of flowing blue waves of [[madra]] that imitate the appearance of [[water]]. Though it was once believed to possess a [[water]] aspect and was intended for an individual with [[pure madra]], [[Lindon]] successfully obtained the entity from the Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School. Following its acquisition, the small creature, which is only the size of a finger, can be seen playing within a [[tank]].}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] is a natural [[spirit]] born from accumulated [[vital aura]] in locations where power exists in perfect balance. Originally appearing as a translucent bright blue doll, the [[spirit]] acquired by [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] transformed into a deep azure woman with long hair and a dress. Kept within a scripted glass case that features a specific flaw for opening, the entity can be fed [[madra]] coins which dissolve upon contact. This malleable being is capable of pouring liquid blue through [[madra channels]] to provide soothing relief and can even hop onto [[Lindon]]'s shoulder to sit. During his journey, [[Lindon]] attempted to utilize the [[spirit]]'s abilities to heal [[Orthos]].}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Known as [[Little Blue]], the [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] is a [[spirit]] that [[Lindon]] intends to retrieve from his pack. This entity produces a long, slow tone reminiscent of a flute and once directed a worried look toward [[Orthos]]. As a [[spirit]], it is sustained by [[Lindon]] feeding it with his [[pure core]]. Eventually, the [[Sylvan]] [[Riverseed]] is carried upon [[Lindon]]'s shoulder.}}
